newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian helicopter crash kills three.
newsitem.headline: Russian helicopter crash kills three.

text.p: A Russian military helicopter has crashed during a training flight, killing three crew members, Interfax news agency said on Saturday.
Citing the emergencies ministry, Interfax said the helicopter crashed late on Friday in the Ulyanovsk region, about 600 km (370 miles) southeast of Moscow.
The agency said the aircraft belonged to the Syzran Higher Military Pilots School and that an investigation into the crash had been launched.
Interfax, quoting figures issued by Russia's Federal Aviation Service, said that 66 people were killed in air crashes in the first half of this year, compared to 35 in the same period in 1996.
